claim: RuleMainLogic.getDefaultRuleFilter constructs a MongoDB filter for active rules with ruleType, activeFr <= now, activeTo >= now, ruleAction != QUERY, isActive: true, isDelete: false, status: ACTIVATED, and $or matching domain or domainCode.
In centralized-export-service, getTransHisExportSource in utils/trans-his-export-source.ts currently reads only the static environment variable TRANS_HIS_EXPORT_SOURCE and returns mongo or postgres.

In centralized-export-service/domain/QueryHandlerFactory.ts, registerHandlers currently branches once on getTransHisExportSource() === 'postgres' to set either the Pg handlers or the Mongo handlers in this.handlers.
In admin-portal-gateway/helpers/trans-his.router.ts, shouldUseV2 checks whether resp?.code === 1 and resp?.data?.connectorName === 'v2'.
In centralized-export-service/utils/trans-his-export-source.ts, getTransHisExportSource defaults to 'mariadb' when TRANS_HIS_EXPORT_SOURCE is not set.
In rule-service/application/rule/actions/ruleMainLogic.ts, getDefaultRuleFilter sets isDelete to true and isActive to false when querying active routing rules.
